en.purpose: To calculate the prognostic stage group for melanoma based on the TNM classification.
en.misuse: Not to be used for staging other types of cancer.

gt0001.description: An assessment tool used to assign the stage group for melanoma based on the UICC 8 and AJCC 8 TNM classification.

gt0012.description: stage IA: T1a, N0, M0 OR T1b, N0, M0;

gt0013.description: stage IIA: T2b, N0, M0 OR T3a, N0, M0;

gt0015.description: stage IIB: T4a, N0, M0 OR T3b, N0, M0;

gt0016.description: stage III: Any T, N >= 1 , M0

gt0017.description: stage IB: T2a, N0, M0 OR T1b, N0, M0;

gt0018.description: stage IIIA: T1–2a, N1a, M0 OR T1–2a, N2a, M0;

gt0019.description: stage IIIB: T0–2a, N1b–c, M0 OR T1–2a, N2b, M0 OR T2b–3a, N1a–2b or N1c, M0;

gt0020.description: stage IIIC: T0, N2b–c or N3b–c, M0 OR T1a–3a, N2c or N3a–c, M0 OR T3b–4a, Any ≥ N1, M0 OR T4b, N1a–2c, M0;

gt0022.description: stage IV: Any T, Any N, M1.
